plugins.name: spanish-weave
plugins.description: For Claude Code on your computer (uses hooks). On claude.ai or the Claude apps, add spanish-weave-chat instead. Weaves a few Latin American Spanish words into Claude's chat replies, at your level, and syncs your words with the Spanish Weave Chrome extension.

plugins.name: spanish-weave-chat
plugins.description: For claude.ai and the Claude apps (iPhone, Android, web, desktop chat): Spanish Weave as a skill, nothing to install on a computer. Pick this one in Customize > Plugins.
